package gateways

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// Status reads the verified machine's own record.
func Status(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports StatusPorts,
	in models.StatusRequest,
) (models.GatewayStatus, error) {
	return ports.Registry.Status(ctx, e, in)
}
